what_it_is.prose: VSMPO-AVISMA (PJSC VSMPO-AVISMA Corporation, Verkhnyaya Salda, Russia; Rostec-affiliated) is the world's largest producer of aerospace-grade titanium — ingots, mill products and forgings — and has long been a strategic upstream supplier to Boeing and Airbus, which signed multi-year titanium supply and technology-collaboration agreements with it. Following Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, sanctions pressure led Boeing to suspend purchases of Russian titanium while Airbus continued sourcing for a period, highlighting Western aerospace's dependence on this single Russian supplier. VSMPO-AVISMA's relevance to India's military-aerospace picture is indirect: it is an upstream raw-material producer rather than a platform, engine or systems supplier, and no established direct India defence-aerospace supply contract was found in public sources reviewed. This is therefore a compact (Tier C) card capturing the titanium supply-chain dimension; it can be elevated if primary-source evidence of a direct India footprint emerges.

open_questions: No documented direct VSMPO-AVISMA supply relationship with Indian defence-aerospace programmes was found in sources reviewed.
